title: Large-scale Usage of Open Infrastructure Software
body:
Watch the Videos

 

Schedule of Events (time in UTC)

  • Upgrade challenges
  • Different approaches in large-scale deployments
Day 1 - June 29
13:00-13:30   Kick-off
13:30-14:20   User Stories
Moderator: Mark Collier
  • Blizzard, Verizon, & OpenInfra Labs will share their user stories
  • Collecting scaling stories, to help with the SIG goal of pushing back cluster scaling limits
  • Integration of different OpenStack projects at scale
  • What do you give up in your large cluster as you scale?

https://etherpad.opendev.org/p/OpenDev_LargeScale_UserStories
14:20-14:30   -- 10 min Break --
14:30-16:00   Upgrades
Moderator: Belmiro Moreira
  • Upgrade challenges
  • Different upgrade approaches for large-scale deployments

https://etherpad.opendev.org/p/OpenDev_LargeScale_Upgrades

 

Day 2 - June 30
13:00-13:15   Kick-off
13:15-14:05   Tools

https://etherpad.opendev.org/p/OpenDev_LargeScale_Tools
14:05-14:10   -- 5 min Break --
14:10-15:00   High Availability Networking Solutions
Moderator: Beth Cohen

https://etherpad.opendev.org/p/OpenDev_LargeScale_HANetworkingSolutions
15:00-15:10   -- 10 min Break --
15:10-16:00   Software Stack
Moderator: Masahito Muroi
  • How the software stack changes considering the size of the deployment (using k8s, or puppet and ansible, etc)
  • Best practice and anti-pattern you find in your software stack
  • Do you want to change your software stack? If so, why?

https://etherpad.opendev.org/p/OpenDev_LargeScale_SoftwareStack

 

Day 3 - July 1
13:00-13:15   Kick-off
13:15-14:05   Baremetal
Moderator: James Penick
  • Bare metal cluster scaling specifics

https://etherpad.opendev.org/p/OpenDev_LargeScale_Baremetal
14:05-14:15   -- 10 min Break --
14:15-15:15   Edge
Moderator: Shuquan Huang
  • Centralized compute vs distributed compute for NFV and edge computing use case

https://etherpad.opendev.org/p/OpenDev_LargeScale_Edge
15:15-16:00   Wrap-Up

https://etherpad.opendev.org/p/OpenDev_LargeScale_WrapUp
